full_prompt_en: An intricately drawn, hand-colored literary illustration shows a bespectacled scholar seated at a desk covered with maps and papers. He occupies the lower right of the image, bent toward a broad pale sheet whose small linework echoes the streets visible beyond the central window. The study is filled with inset pictures, shelves, instruments, a small lamp, and a round clock; each object is rendered with tiny contour marks that reward close looking. A tall rectangular window forms the main opening in the dense room. Through it, a warm terracotta city stretches toward the horizon under a cream sky, while a large blue and orange bird crosses the upper opening and casts an almost emblematic shape. The room's side panels contain miniature scenes and ornamental fragments, so the image reads at once as a lived-in interior and a layered illustrated page. Narrow black and gray ink lines, crosshatching, and repeated architectural strokes build fine texture over flat or lightly washed color. The palette is dominated by teal and deep ultramarine, with warm ochre, terracotta, cream, and small orange accents. Sunlight strikes the paper and window edges, but shadows remain graphic and gently tinted rather than physically smooth. Foreground desk, framed middle distance, and crowded far city form a sequence of nested planes. The busy surfaces are held together by strong rectangular divisions and the calm concentration of the seated figure. The image feels inventive, bookish, and slightly dreamlike, as if observation and imagination share the same illustrated room.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅精细绘制、手工上色的文学插画呈现戴眼镜的学者坐在铺满地图和纸张的书桌前。他占据画面右下，俯向宽阔浅色纸页，其细密线条呼应中央窗口外可见的街道。书房布满嵌套画面、架子、仪器、小灯和圆钟；每件物品都用微小轮廓笔痕绘出，值得近看。高矩形窗是密集房间里的主要开口。窗外，暖陶土色城市向奶油色天空下的地平线延展，一只大蓝橙鸟掠过上方窗洞，投出近似徽记的形状。房间侧壁画面包含微型场景和装饰片段，使图像既像有人生活的室内，又像层叠的插画书页。窄黑灰墨线、交叉排线和重复的建筑短笔在平涂或轻罩染色上建立细密纹理。配色由青绿和深群青主导，配暖赭、陶土、奶油和少量橙点。阳光落在纸和窗边，但阴影仍图形化、略带颜色，而非物理般平滑。前景书桌、中景框景与拥挤的远城形成套叠平面序列。繁忙表面由强烈矩形分区和坐者的安静专注收拢。画面富于发明性、书卷气且稍显梦境，仿佛观察与想象共享同一间插画房间。
style_prompt_en: Intricate ink drawing under hand-colored washes gives the surface a dense literary and decorative character. Fine black-gray contours, short repeated strokes, and delicate crosshatching describe small forms without relying on smooth photographic modeling. Teal and deep blue establish the large cool structure, while cream, ochre, terracotta, and small orange notes warm selected openings and details. Rectangular frames, inset planes, and nested scale shifts organize an otherwise abundant field of miniature marks. A pale central interval provides visual breathing room between crowded darker margins. Color lies in broad matte patches or thin washes, and linework remains legible across both. Light is graphic and selective: bright paper-like planes contrast with deep blue-green areas, yet shadows retain colored texture. Near, middle, and far layers are separated by overlap, framing, and detail density more than by optical blur. The rhythm alternates ornamental compression with larger open shapes, producing a learned, imaginative, slightly dreamlike illustrated finish.
style_prompt_zh: 手工上色罩染下的精密墨线绘画赋予表面浓厚的文学性和装饰性。细黑灰轮廓、短促重复笔痕与纤细交叉排线描出小形体，却不依赖平滑的摄影式塑造。青绿与深蓝建立大块冷色结构，奶油、赭黄、陶土和少量橙色温暖选定开口与细节。矩形框、嵌套平面和层中有层的尺度变化整理原本繁多的微小笔痕。中央浅色间隔在拥挤较暗的边缘之间提供呼吸空间。颜色以哑光大块或薄罩染铺下，线条在两者之上仍清晰可读。光线有图形性和选择性：亮纸般平面与深蓝绿色区域对比，阴影却保留有色纹理。近、中、远层主要由叠压、框景和细节密度而非光学模糊分开。节奏在装饰的压缩和更大开放形之间交替，形成博学、富想象且略带梦境的插画饰面。
theme_en: A scholar studies maps while a bright city and a bird appear through the study window
theme_zh: 学者在书房研究地图，明亮城市和飞鸟出现在窗外
name: Alasdair Gray
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
